about: Per-function disposition for all 14,287 entries of register FD-171 (the DLL-export-census long tail), produced by the FD-171 lane, 2026-11-05. Implemented entries are proven by web/tests/suite/browser/fd171-contracts{64,32}.test.mjs and the regenerated census baseline in this change; every other entry carries the reason it was left. Upstream reference: Wine master c42c1532a8b8a767d5e23b527ea874368c202ed0.

categories.implemented-fd171: Genuinely implemented by this lane (FD-171) and proven by the guest contract fixtures; the census baseline drop for the entry is in this change.
categories.implemented-sibling-fd167: Implemented by the sibling FD-167 lane on the same census base; composition takes the union.
categories.upstream-still-stub: Upstream Wine, through master commit c42c1532a8b8a767d5e23b527ea874368c202ed0, still ships this export as a winebuild stub: there is no upstream implementation to backport, and the correct behaviour cannot be lifted from any authoritative source available to this lane, so it is left rather than guessed.
categories.absent-from-upstream: The export does not appear in upstream Wine master's spec for this DLL at all: legacy, undocumented, or vendor-internal surface with no authoritative contract available; left rather than guessed.
categories.upstream-stub-body: A body exists upstream but is itself a stub; see the entry reason.
categories.upstream-semi-stub-rejected: Upstream's body is a semi-stub that answers wrongly or partially for known inputs; rejected so the census never rewards a dressed-up stub.
categories.upstream-noop-indistinguishable: Upstream's body is a no-op indistinguishable from the stub; rejected so the census never rewards it.
categories.blocked-missing-subsystem: The honest implementation needs machinery that does not exist in the shipped vintage; see the entry reason.
categories.blocked-missing-data: The honest implementation needs data the vintage never records; see the entry reason.
categories.blocked-missing-target: A forwarder/import whose target does not exist (or is itself a stub) in the vintage; see the entry reason.
categories.blocked-abi-pair: Blocked by a shared-ABI pairing with a stock component; see the entry reason.
categories.subsystem-rewrite-not-ported: Implemented upstream only as part of a subsystem rewrite that post-dates the shipped vintage; see the entry reason.
categories.untestable-no-wow64: No guest that could call it can exist on this emulator; see the entry reason.
